object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Give text holding U+001B to each of: create an object, set a description, set an attribute, set the title, add a link (as its type), set a table cell, create a view, create a filter. Through the document service, give U+0000 in a description, U+0000 in an attribute value of a new or updated object, and U+0000 in a link type. Expected: each is refused and no file changes; each of the eight errors names U+001B, and the description's names U+0000.
